sun.awt.dnd

类 SunDropTargetContextPeer

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.awt.dnd.SunDropTargetContextPeer
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Transferable, DropTargetContextPeer

    public abstract class SunDropTargetContextPeer
extends Object
implements DropTargetContextPeer, Transferable

    The SunDropTargetContextPeer class is the generic class responsible for handling the interaction between a windowing systems DnD system and Java.

    从以下版本开始:
    JDK1.3.1
